bio: Byran Peters is an Oshawa, Ontario mortgage broker with The Mortgage Doctors Inc. who offers first-time buyer, private, reverse, debt consolidation, bruised credit and second mortgages. He says funding can take 1-2 business days in Oshawa and 1-3 across Ontario once documents are in. His about page is partly personal (family, born 24.5 weeks premature).
tagline: Unlocking Dreams, One Mortgage at a Time
